error.fieldUnknown.purpose: Error when Use on a look-up names a detail it doesn't set (only title, artist, mix, remixer, label, year, album and catalogue number).

error.valueEmpty.purpose: Error when Use on a look-up is given a blank value; clearing a detail isn't done with Use.

error.notSendable.purpose: Error when a value given to Use has a character rekordbox can't take, or a year that isn't a number.

lookUp.title.purpose: Heading of the panel with identification suggestions for the selected track.
lookUp.title.where: Track details, after the Audio model panel.

lookUp.action.purpose: Button that asks the online services that are on about this track, when it has not been looked up.
lookUp.action.where: Look up panel, in Track details.

lookUp.again.purpose: The same button once the track has been looked up before.
lookUp.again.where: Look up panel, in Track details.

lookUp.selected_one.purpose: Button that looks up all the selected tracks (one-track form).
lookUp.selected_one.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Shown when several tracks are selected.

lookUp.selected_other.purpose: Button that looks up all the selected tracks.
lookUp.selected_other.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Shown when several tracks are selected.

lookUp.palette.purpose: Command palette entry that looks up the selected tracks online.
lookUp.palette.where: Command palette, while a track is selected and an online service is on.

lookUp.off.purpose: Says why Look up is disabled, and that offline suggestions still show.
lookUp.off.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Under the Look up button, when every online service is off.

lookUp.loading.purpose: Shown while the suggestions are being fetched.
lookUp.loading.where: Look up panel, in Track details.

lookUp.nothing.purpose: Says there is no suggestion at all for the track.
lookUp.nothing.where: Look up panel, in Track details.

lookUp.status.never.purpose: Status line for a track that has never been looked up.
lookUp.status.never.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Top status line.

lookUp.status.queued.purpose: Status line while the look-up is queued.
lookUp.status.queued.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Top status line.

lookUp.status.running.purpose: Status line while the look-up runs.
lookUp.status.running.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Top status line.

lookUp.status.found_one.purpose: Status line after a look-up that found one detail, when no online source is known.
lookUp.status.found_one.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Top status line.

lookUp.status.found_other.purpose: Status line after a look-up that found details, when no online source is known.
lookUp.status.found_other.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Top status line.

lookUp.status.foundFrom_one.purpose: Status line after a look-up that found one detail; names the source and when.
lookUp.status.foundFrom_one.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Top status line.

lookUp.status.foundFrom_other.purpose: Status line after a look-up that found details; names the source and when.
lookUp.status.foundFrom_other.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Top status line.

lookUp.status.nothing.purpose: Status line after a look-up that found nothing, with no reason known.
lookUp.status.nothing.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Top status line.

lookUp.status.nothingWhy.purpose: Status line after a look-up that found nothing, with the reason.
lookUp.status.nothingWhy.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Top status line.

lookUp.status.failed.purpose: Status line after a failed look-up, with no reason known.
lookUp.status.failed.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Top status line.

lookUp.status.failedWhy.purpose: Status line after a failed look-up, with the reason.
lookUp.status.failedWhy.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Top status line.

lookUp.status.skipped.purpose: Status line when a look-up was skipped, with no reason known.
lookUp.status.skipped.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Top status line.

lookUp.status.skippedWhy.purpose: Status line when a look-up was skipped, with the reason.
lookUp.status.skippedWhy.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Top status line.

lookUp.later.purpose: Says a newer look-up failed but the earlier good answer is kept.
lookUp.later.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Under the status line.

lookUp.reason.services_off.purpose: Reason a look-up was skipped: all services off.
lookUp.reason.services_off.where: Look up panel, in Track details. In the status line.

lookUp.reason.acoustid_off.purpose: Reason a look-up was skipped: AcoustID is not switched on. Names the Settings panel.
lookUp.reason.acoustid_off.where: Look up panel, in Track details. In the status line.

lookUp.reason.musicbrainz_off.purpose: Reason a look-up was skipped: MusicBrainz is not switched on. Names the Settings panel.
lookUp.reason.musicbrainz_off.where: Look up panel, in Track details. In the status line.

lookUp.reason.key_missing.purpose: Reason a look-up was skipped: the app's AcoustID key is not filled in. Names the Settings panel.
lookUp.reason.key_missing.where: Look up panel, in Track details. In the status line.

lookUp.reason.no_fingerprint.purpose: Reason: the audio has not been fingerprinted yet.
lookUp.reason.no_fingerprint.where: Look up panel, in Track details. In the status line.

lookUp.reason.no_match.purpose: Reason: AcoustID found no sure match.
lookUp.reason.no_match.where: Look up panel, in Track details. In the status line.

lookUp.reason.no_details.purpose: Reason: the recordings found had no usable details.
lookUp.reason.no_details.where: Look up panel, in Track details. In the status line.

lookUp.reason.offline.where: Look up panel, in Track details. In the status line.

lookUp.reason.busy.purpose: Reason: a service asked the app to slow down.
lookUp.reason.busy.where: Look up panel, in Track details. In the status line.

lookUp.reason.refused.where: Look up panel, in Track details. In the status line.

lookUp.reason.bad_reply.purpose: Reason: a service's answer could not be read.
lookUp.reason.bad_reply.where: Look up panel, in Track details. In the status line.

lookUp.reason.failed.where: Look up panel, in Track details. In the status line.

lookUp.reason.other.purpose: Reason for a code this version has no words for; shows the code as the app sent it.
lookUp.reason.other.where: Look up panel, in Track details. In the status line.

lookUp.asked.queued_one.purpose: Says one track's look-up was started.
lookUp.asked.queued_one.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Under the buttons.

lookUp.asked.queued_other.purpose: Says the look-up of several tracks was started.
lookUp.asked.queued_other.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Under the buttons.

lookUp.asked.none.purpose: Says nothing was started because no selected track is a Library track with a file.
lookUp.asked.none.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Under the buttons.

lookUp.field.Name.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Row label.

lookUp.field.Artist.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Row label.

lookUp.field.Mix.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Row label.

lookUp.field.Remixer.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Row label.

lookUp.field.Label.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Row label.

lookUp.field.Year.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Row label.

lookUp.field.Album.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Row label.

lookUp.field.CatalogueNumber.purpose: Name of the catalogue number detail.
lookUp.field.CatalogueNumber.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Row label.

lookUp.current.purpose: The value the track has now, above its suggestions.
lookUp.current.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Under a row label.

lookUp.currentNone.purpose: Says the track has no value for the detail now.
lookUp.currentNone.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Under a row label.

lookUp.source.tags.purpose: Names the file's tags as a suggestion's source.
lookUp.source.tags.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Beside a suggestion.

lookUp.source.fileName.purpose: Names the file name as a suggestion's source.
lookUp.source.fileName.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Beside a suggestion.

lookUp.source.sibling.purpose: Names another file of the same track as a suggestion's source.
lookUp.source.sibling.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Beside a suggestion.

lookUp.source.online.purpose: Names an online service as a suggestion's source.
lookUp.source.online.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Beside a suggestion.

lookUp.source.nameSearch.purpose: Names a MusicBrainz suggestion that came from searching by title and artist, not from a fingerprint.
lookUp.source.nameSearch.where: Look up panel, in Track details. After a suggestion, naming where it came from.

lookUp.source.onlineVia.purpose: Names an online service and the service that led to it.
lookUp.source.onlineVia.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Beside a suggestion.

lookUp.source.other.purpose: A source this version has no words for; shows its kind as the app sent it.
lookUp.source.other.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Beside a suggestion.

lookUp.sourceSeparator.purpose: Joins several sources of one suggestion.
lookUp.sourceSeparator.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Beside a suggestion.

lookUp.use.purpose: Button that sets one suggestion as the track's own value.
lookUp.use.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Beside a suggestion.

lookUp.useValue.purpose: Screen-reader name of a Use button.
lookUp.useValue.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Beside a suggestion. (not shown)

lookUp.useAll.purpose: Button that uses the first suggestion of every row shown, as one step.
lookUp.useAll.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Under the rows, when more than one row is shown.

lookUp.discogsCredit.purpose: Credits Discogs, as its terms ask, whenever a suggestion shown came from it.
lookUp.discogsCredit.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Under the suggestions.

lookUp.cover.loading.purpose: Says the cover is being fetched.
lookUp.cover.loading.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Above the suggestions, while the cover loads.

lookUp.cover.none.purpose: Says the cover could not be fetched.
lookUp.cover.none.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Above the suggestions, when fetching the cover failed.

lookUp.cover.alt.purpose: Describes the cover picture to a screen reader when the release's album name isn't known.
lookUp.cover.alt.where: Look up panel, in Track details. The cover picture's alt text.

lookUp.cover.altAlbum.purpose: Describes the cover picture to a screen reader, naming the album.
lookUp.cover.altAlbum.where: Look up panel, in Track details. The cover picture's alt text.

lookUp.used_one.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Under the rows.

lookUp.used_other.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Under the rows.

lookUp.usedNothing.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Under the rows.

lookUp.catalogueNote.purpose: Says the catalogue number stays in the app.
lookUp.catalogueNote.where: Look up panel, in Track details. Under the rows, when a catalogue number is suggested.
